newsitem.title: USA: Harcourt to buy some Times Mirror book rights.
newsitem.headline: Harcourt to buy some Times Mirror book rights.

text.p: Harcourt General Inc said on Friday it agreed to acquire exclusive marketing and sales rights to The Times Mirror Co's Mosby-Year Book professional medical publications.
Harcourt said in a statement its publishing arm, Harcourt Brace & Co, would buy the marketing and sales rights for most parts of the world outside the United States.
Harcourt & Brace, which was not immediately available to comment on the deal, published medical and health books through its W.B. Saunders Co subsidiary.

Harcourt Brace President and Chief Executive Officer Brian Knez said the deal, which would be phased in by the end of the calendar year, would help it strengthen its presence in Canada, Europe, Asia and Latin America.

It did not have rights in Germany, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Brazil and the Caribbean, it said. The deal also excluded some Mosby books, like Mosby's Journal, Lifeline and Consumer Health and Safety products.

Knez also said Timothy Hailstone, head of Times Mirror's international professional publishing operations, would become chairman and chief executive officer of London-based Harcourt Brace Publishers International. The current president, Peter Lengemann, would also become chief operating officer, he said.
